title: Universal Scene Graph Generation

layout.note: Three stacked full-width bands: a row of four tinted graph cards, a dashed pale-pink band of raw inputs aligned under them, and a pink-outlined band with five universal graphs in a row; colour-matched block arrows link the bands.

lesson: To show a unification, draw the same instance once per source in one visual grammar with its own coloured header and an arrow from its raw input, then merge them in one wide band below whose items carry small colour stamps for their source. Keep item colours fixed across all graphs.
